footer.$comment: Every pre-answered row and every default the run took for the maintainer; mandatory on every PR whose run took one, idle (HR-334) or attended (HA#474 AC-1), whatever the kind or family. Any positive source includes it: --decisions, --idle, or --decisions-from a nen.run manifest with a non-empty idleAnswers. A manifest proves only launch pre-answers: a null or empty idleAnswers adds nothing beside --decisions or --idle (the flag wins) and refuses alone; a malformed manifest refuses whatever else is passed. A default taken mid-run or attended is --decisions.
